description: This file contains internal Kotlin functions related to handling session keys within the ai.openclaw.app package. It includes utilities for normalizing, validating, resolving IDs, and building session key strings.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw session key string by trimming it or returning a default 'main' if null or empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a raw session key string represents the canonical main session key, considering 'global' or keys starting with 'agent:'.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromMainSessionKey
methods.description: Extracts the agent ID from a session key string if it starts with 'agent:'.

methods.name: buildNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string for a node given device and agent IDs.
